{{Quote|On a positive note, I was impressed with your detention numbers from Sev Tok. Far above quota. I may be sending more of that sort of work your way.|Major Partagaz to Dedra Meero|<ref name="Aldhani">{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}}</ref>}}
'''Sev Tok''' was an astronomical object<ref name="Aldhani" /> in the [[Sev Tok system]] in the [[Kurost sector]] of the [[Mid Rim Territories]].<ref name="Appendix" /> In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="5 BBY">{{AndorDate|104}}</ref> [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Major]] [[Lio Partagaz|Partagaz]] told ISB [[Dedra Meero]] that he was impressed by her detention numbers from the location.<ref name="Aldhani" /> At one point, a meeting was held at Sev Tok concerning the Empire's [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE Defender]] Program. A file titled Sev Tok Meeting was kept to record the proceedings in the [[Imperial Archives]].<ref name="Rise and Fall">''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''</ref>

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sev Tok was first [[canon]]ically mentioned in "[[Aldhani (episode)|Aldhani]]," the fourth episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''.<ref name="Aldhani" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sev Tok/Legends|Sev Tok]] was first mentioned in the article "[[Droids Defiant]]" in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 9|ninth issue]] of the magazine ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''.<ref name="Journal">{{JournalCite|9|Droids Defiant}}</ref>
